description:
We are Astryva, a team of university students passionate about physics, space technology, and innovation. For NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, we aim to develop a web platform that harmonizes MODIS and VIIRS satellite hot spot data. Through interactive maps and visualizations, we hope to improve understanding of historical fire activity and its patterns. We value teamwork, creativity, and scientific accuracy.

Astryva — Beyond Data, Beyond Limits.
